This 2019 Dodge Durango SXT Plus offers the practicality and capability families need in a full-size SUV. With seating for seven passengers and a thoughtfully designed interior, this vehicle provides flexibility for your everyday needs and weekend adventures. The spacious third-row seating accommodates additional passengers comfortably, while the 60/40 fold and tumble second row allows easy reconfiguration for cargo when needed.

Technology integration is straightforward with the Uconnect 4 infotainment system featuring a 7-inch display, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto compatibility. Your favorite content from SiriusXM satellite radio plays through the six-speaker audio system, and steering wheel controls keep you focused on the road. The auto-dimming rearview mirror and trip computer provide helpful information for your journey.

Safety features include a ParkView rear backup camera to assist when reversing, ParkSense rear parking assist with stop functionality, and blind spot and cross path detection to monitor your surroundings. The vehicle is equipped with dual front airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to maintain confident handling in various driving conditions.

This Durango is well-equipped for towing with the Trailer Tow Group IV package, which includes a Class IV receiver hitch, trailer brake control, and rear load leveling suspension for stability when hauling. The heavy-duty engine cooling and 180-amp alternator support sustained performance. The front fog lights and fully automatic headlights enhance visibility, while speed-sensitive wipers adapt to your driving conditions.

Comfort features like heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, and automatic temperature control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning keep all passengers comfortable year-round. Power windows, door mirrors, and a power liftgate add convenience to daily use. The leather-trimmed steering wheel and split-folding rear seat provide additional refinement and flexibility.

At 89,392 miles, this Durango has been well-maintained and is ready for its next owner. The 3.6L V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers reliable performance with 18 city and 25 highway MPG. Come see this capable family SUV at our showroom and discover why Bud Clary has been Washington's trusted source for quality preowned vehicles since 1959.

description:
Discover the ultimate in power, capability, and sophistication with the all-new 2026 Toyota Tundra 1794. This exceptional full-size truck is poised to redefine your driving experience, blending cutting-edge technology, premium comfort, and uncompromising performance.

Boasting a commanding 3.4L V6 engine paired with a smooth-shifting 10-speed automatic transmission and robust 4WD system, the Tundra 1794 delivers exceptional power and traction, whether you're navigating the urban jungle or tackling rugged terrain. With an impressive fuel economy of 17 city/22 highway MPG, this truck strikes the perfect balance between strength and efficiency.

- 12 Speakers
- AM/FM radio: SiriusXM
- Radio data system
- Radio: Premium Audio
- 3.31 Axle Ratio
- Air Conditioning
- Automatic temperature control
- Front dual zone A/C
- Rear window defroster
- Memory seat

The Tundra 1794's exterior is a masterful blend of style and function, featuring a striking Gray finish, chrome accents, and power-folding outside mirrors. Step up with the available power running boards, and you'll enjoy easy access to the spacious and well-appointed cabin.

Inside, the Tundra 1794 pampers you with premium leather seating, heated and ventilated front and rear seats, and a heated steering wheel. The available panoramic view monitor and multi-terrain back monitor provide unparalleled visibility and confidence, whether you're maneuvering in tight spaces or navigating off-road challenges.

Cutting-edge technology is at your fingertips, with features like Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and the Drive Connect Cloud Navigation system. The available Head-Up Display keeps vital information in your line of sight, while the 12-speaker premium audio system delivers a truly immersive listening experience.

Safety is also a top priority, with the Tundra 1794 offering a comprehensive suite of advanced driver-assistance technologies, including Blind Spot Monitor, Brake Assist, and Electronic Stability Control. The Safety Connect system provides emergency assistance at the touch of a button, giving you added peace of mind on every journey.

Elevate your driving experience and explore the unmatched capabilities of the 2026 Toyota Tundra 1794. Visit our showroom today to experience this exceptional full-size truck firsthand and discover why it's the perfect companion for your next adventure.

Electronic messaging assistance with read and voice-operated functions further enhances convenience, ensuring you stay connected without distraction. 2020 Chevrolet Equinox Performance Features Performance-wise, this Equinox features auto start/stop technology to improve fuel efficiency and reduce emissions. This 2024 Buick Enclave Essence represents a modern three-row luxury crossover built to enhance your daily driving experience and accommodate your entire family with confidence.

- Clean Carfax
- Power-sliding moonroof
- Sport Touring Edition with unique sport grille
- 20" gloss black aluminum wheels

- 7-passenger seating with third-row split-bench configuration

Finished in elegant black, this Enclave delivers the visual presence you expect from a premium crossover. The Sport Touring Edition enhances its appearance with a distinctive sport grille, body-color surround, and Sport Touring liftgate badging, while the pitch-dark night lower accent color adds contemporary styling. The 20-inch gloss black aluminum wheels and power-sliding moonroof contribute to both form and function.

Under the hood, the 3.6L V6 SIDI VVT engine with nine-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive provides reliable performance for highway driving and daily commutes, delivering 17 city and 25 highway miles per gallon. The heavy-duty cooling system ensures consistent operation in varied conditions.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully designed cabin that puts passenger comfort first. Perforated leather-appointed seat trim, heated front seats, and comprehensive power seat adjustments allow you to find your ideal driving position. The Buick Infotainment System with wireless smartphone integration keeps you connected, while SiriusXM 360L satellite radio expands your entertainment options. Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning ensures all passengers stay comfortable.

Practical features enhance daily usability: all-weather floor liners protect your investment, the integrated cargo liner simplifies loading, and the power liftgate offers convenient access. For those who tow, the 5,000-pound trailering package includes hitch guidance with hitch view, making trailer connection and positioning straightforward.

Safety and security are prioritized with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and a security system. OnStar and Buick connected services provide additional peace of mind.

This 2006 Chevrolet Malibu LT 2LT offers a dependable driving experience with solid construction and practical features that make daily commuting straightforward and comfortable.

- Power tilt-sliding sunroof
- 3.5L SFI V6 engine with 4-speed automatic transmission
- Heated side mirrors
- Power-adjustable gas and brake pedals
- Power driver seat
- ETR AM/FM stereo with 6-disc in-dash CD changer
- Dual-stage frontal airbags with side-impact and head curtain airbags
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- All-speed traction control
- Remote vehicle starter system
- Rear spoiler
- Leather steering wheel
- Telescoping steering wheel

This Malibu delivers practical performance with its 3.5L V6 engine, achieving 22 city MPG and 32 highway MPG. The four-speed automatic transmission with overdrive provides efficient operation across varied driving conditions. Four-wheel independent suspension and all-speed traction control work together to maintain stability and control whether you're navigating city streets or highway driving.

The cabin combines comfort with convenience. Power-adjustable gas and brake pedals accommodate different driver preferences, while the power driver seat allows you to find your ideal driving position. The power tilt-sliding sunroof adds an open-air option for pleasant days. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and telescoping adjustment give you command of the vehicle with personalized positioning.

Entertainment and information keep you connected during every journey. The ETR AM/FM stereo with six-disc in-dash CD changer, radio data system, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage your music without taking your hands off the wheel. The driver information center displays outside temperature and trip data for practical reference.

Safety receives focused attention throughout this vehicle. Dual-stage frontal airbags complement thorax side-impact airbags and head curtain side airbags at front and rear outboard seating positions. Four-wheel antilock disc brakes with speed-sensing operation provide confident stopping power. Remote keyless entry with enhanced security features and a panic alarm add layers of protection and convenience.

This gray sedan comes with a clean vehicle history, one-owner service record, and represents a recent trade-in. The heated side mirrors, rear window defroster, and automatic headlights round out the practical features that make daily driving more manageable. Invite us to show you this Malibu and experience how its straightforward functionality and balanced features serve your transportation needs.
